Portfolio Monitor (simulated)

Cumulative return vs benchmark

Time-weighted, net of fees. External capital flows excluded from the numerator.
Portfolio Benchmark

Drawdown from peak

Peak-to-trough decline of the time-weighted index.

Exposure by sector

Gross notional as a share of NAV. Delta-adjusted, so the two legs of a spread cannot double-count the underlying. Futures carry no market value, so exposure is measured on notional.

Component VaR by sector

Euler decomposition — each sector's marginal contribution to total portfolio VaR. Sums to total, so a diversifying sector can read negative.

Stress scenarios

Instantaneous revaluation. Options repriced with delta and gamma; rate exposure through DV01.

Income received

Dividends, bond coupons and cash-sweep interest — accrued from the blotter, not typed in.
Dividends Coupons Cash interest

Desk performance

Each desk's own NAV — its allocated capital, the cash its trades moved, and what it holds today. Pick a window and every figure below recalculates. Cash is what the desk is holding at the end of that window.
or to

Holdings

One row per position, over the window selected above. Option legs roll up into the strategy that owns them — click a strategy to see its legs, and any row to open it.
Select a row above to open it.

Options book — Greeks

Position Greeks: delta in underlying shares, gamma per $1 move, vega per vol point, theta per day.

Fixed income risk

Modified duration, convexity and DV01, with the income the book has actually received — coupons and fund distributions kept apart, because they are different things.

Simulated portfolio. This is a paper-trading book run by a student club for education. No real money is invested, no trades are executed, and every dollar figure is hypothetical. Nothing on this page is investment advice.

Every figure on this page is derived from three flat inputs — instruments, transactions and prices. No number is typed twice, and no cell holds a hardcoded result. Option marks use Black–Scholes with a 60-day realised-vol proxy; substitute Bloomberg IVOL_MID for production reporting.
